option.description: One exact catalogue choice label, or a precise numerical value in the configured unit.

source_text.description: Copy exact supporting words from the current offer, or from the earlier offer when this choice is carried forward.

from_previous_offer.description: True only for an earlier choice retained through an explicit reference in the new offer.

question.description: One brief, friendly question that explains what is needed to understand this choice.

source_text.description: Copy the unclear offer wording; use an empty string for a required issue that was not mentioned.

novel_terms.description: Plausible proposed features outside this catalogue, kept in the person's own words without points.

unsupported_terms.description: Unrelated or impossible requests, separate from genuine negotiation choices.

offer_intent.description: A partial proposal or list of requested features is still an offer; missing required choices can be clarified.

explicit_reference.description: Copy the current words asking to keep earlier choices, or use an empty string when there is no reference.

interpretation_notes.description: Brief useful notes about how a choice or a supplied scenario convention was read.
